name: telemetry
summary: Discover a two-hop relationship, retain an orphan event, and compare two plausible mapping repairs.
metricSql: SELECT z.area AS group_name, count(*)::text AS records, sum(e.magnitude)::text AS total FROM stellane_demo_telemetry.event_log e LEFT JOIN stellane_demo_telemetry.device_inventory d ON e.device_hint=d.device_token LEFT JOIN stellane_demo_telemetry.zone_registry z ON d.zone_ref=z.zone_key WHERE e.state='active' GROUP BY z.area ORDER BY z.area NULLS LAST
fingerprintSql: SELECT md5(jsonb_build_object('zones',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(z) ORDER BY zone_key) FROM stellane_demo_telemetry.zone_registry z),'devices',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY device_token) FROM stellane_demo_telemetry.device_inventory d),'events',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY event_no) FROM stellane_demo_telemetry.event_log e))::text) AS fingerprint
interpretation: Both repairs restore full coverage and preserve 5 events / 150 units. Coverage alone does not establish whether North or South is correct; choose only with external business evidence.
